F1.reason: Automatic admission requires a new visible human row; hidden duplicates, effects and polls cannot re-arm it. No deferral-consumption probe remains.

F2.reason: Positive exact token envelope; ordinary, bold, explain-then-line and wrong-token replies fail closed.

F3.reason: Empty completion ends the attempt without chat or pause.

F4.reason: Owner+stored-id keyed attempts replace the global wait and global in-flight lock.

F5.reason: Mark follows exact successor identity and durable first-user-message confirmation; failed notes retained with Copy action.

F6.reason: Durable attempts/pauses and exact stored-id remapping; history reconciliation without request/seed replay; unload invalidates old continuations.

F7.reason: Owner and both IDs captured synchronously before any await; route resolved by immutable owner pair.

F8.reason: Chip/gauge/focus/poll are read-only. Only human completion or explicit manual click starts an attempt.

F9.reason: Timeout disposer keyed to attempt id, cancelled on end/reset/unload; generation guards stale continuations.

F10.reason: Title base trimmed to reserve number suffix within 40 characters.

F11.reason: No recent-row scan or fallback; only the confirmed exact successor is titled.

F12.reason: Gateway request now finish-first with the same token protocol. Skill text is proposed in skill_edit only, deliberately not edited.

F13.reason: Public scoped host.skills.list checked before automatic submission; missing/disabled skill skips and notices once per owner/load.

F14.reason: Live dependency-sensitive effects, whole-plugin event tests, shared storage, receipts, failed seed, restart, unload, timers and reset. Retired source-shape assertions documented.

D1.reason: Same as F1; no not-yet loop, warning or pause without another human completion.

D2.reason: Same as F7; switches during title/context lookup cannot recapture ownership.

D3.reason: Reproduced title-await admission race fixed by generation/busy checks after every admission await and final backend idle snapshot. Turn reply correlated by user_row_id. Public host lacks atomic idle-only submission: residual transport gap documented, not claimed solved.

D4.reason: Amended rule 8: create and seed exact owner-routed session IDs; no draft/composer API used.

D5.reason: No preview/recency matching or focused-chat title fallback; exact confirmed stored id only.

D6.reason: Same as F5; no mark without durable first-message confirmation.

D7.reason: Same as F9; earlier attempt timer cannot warn/abandon newer one.

D8.reason: Reset bumps durable generation, cancels all timers, clears marks/pauses/attempts, and invalidates asynchronous starts.

D9.reason: Pauses, seen human rows and attempts persist; reload cannot bypass pause or resend hidden request.

D10.reason: Captured connection-qualified owner resolved through profileRoutes and retained throughout; never reroutes through current source.

D11.reason: Anchored exact first line and delimiters with token, optional one whole-reply fence, no markdown/preamble normalization.

D12.reason: Same as F10; suffix room reserved.

G1.reason: Documented, not fixed: watchdog snapshot is not atomic event-loop reset admission. Watchdog remains off by default; no settings changed.

G2.reason: Running-route guard now precedes timeout cleanup, retaining active request/note.

G3.reason: Validated _read_pending is required before reset scheduling, not file existence alone.

G4.reason: Documented, not fixed per Frasier amendment: carry is consumed before authorization/durable admission. Needs separate gateway admission design; off watchdog does not itself fix manual carry.

G5.reason: Documented, not fixed: host isolation intentionally withholds live runner/session-store objects; no isolation weakening.

skill_edit.action: proposal only; no skill edit staged/applied
skill_edit.old_text: - **Finish the work in hand before the hand-off, and leave nothing half-saved.** A relay request that arrives mid-task is not a reason to stop: unfinished or uncommitted work in a shared repository fails `check` and leaves a mess the next session must untangle, and he counts a hand-off that interrupts unfinished work as a failure. Finish and commit it; if finishing needs his answer, answer `Session Relay: no hand-off:` naming that question rather than abandoning the work.
skill_edit.replacement_text: - **Finish the work in hand before the hand-off, and leave nothing half-saved.** Finish the existing task when it can finish without his answer, then commit and push its changes before running `check`. For a token-bearing Session Relay request, use the exact token from that request: reply with `Session Relay <token> hand-off` as the first line and only the check's printed prompt after it; if finishing needs his answer, reply only `Session Relay <token> not yet: <what is needed>`; for another reason the check cannot pass, reply only `Session Relay <token> no hand-off: <reason>`. No preamble, markdown emphasis or ordinary answer is a hand-off; one code fence around the entire reply is allowed. The plugin seeds only the text after the hand-off first line. This token protocol overrides the legacy Session Relay formatting in Procedure step 6; a normal hand-off requested by a person still ends with the copyable prompt.
skill_edit.companion_procedure_step_6_replacement: 6. **Run `check` until it exits 0,** then end a normal human-requested hand-off with the prompt it printed in one copyable code block. For a token-bearing Session Relay request, use its exact three-line-form protocol as described under Pitfalls: the hand-off first line followed by the printed prompt, or the single not-yet/no-hand-off line. Do not use the legacy untagged Session Relay reply format.
